content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Alexandria

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—but no work experience. If you hold a high school diploma or higher, you're eligible to start. This makes CAPM ideal for career changers and early-stage professionals entering project management roles.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses core project management knowledge into a focused schedule, delivered by active certified practitioners. You'll master PMBOK® fundamentals and exam-aligned content entirely online from anywhere.

steps_items.heading: Submit PMI Application and Fee
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute and complete the CAPM application. Confirm your eligibility details and submit payment for the exam. PMI will review your application; once approved, you'll receive scheduling authorization and exam instructions.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to reinforce knowledge and build confidence. When ready, schedule your proctored CAPM exam through PMI's testing partner. The exam tests your mastery of project management processes and PMBOK® domains.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, you'll enter a three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units through approved training, conferences, or volunteer leadership roles. Plan your PDU strategy early to ensure continuous credential compliance and ongoing career growth.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
